description: Roadmap for the card authorization and double-entry ledger project, sequenced by subsystem rather than by week.
note: docs/design/ (start at docs/design/README.md) is the source of truth for the data model, API shape, invariants, ADRs, cost model, and security posture. Where this roadmap and the design doc disagree, the design doc wins. This roadmap stays high level; if a phase needs step-by-step detail, that belongs in a separate document, not here.

status_legend.in_progress: Started; specifics recorded in the phase's `notes` field.

phases.name: Authorization Service
phases.goal: Stand up the core authorize/capture/void write path as a real service on the single-table design, replacing the toy items service.
includes: Authorization service: authorize, capture, void, merchant creation
API Gateway routes with Cognito JWT authorization
phases.exit_criteria: authorize/capture/void work end to end and idempotently, behind Cognito auth, with expired holds released automatically.
phases.notes: Currently implemented ledger table, merchant and account creation. Authorization service is in progress.

phases.name: DynamoDB Streams
phases.goal: Make ledger writes observable to the rest of the system.
includes: DynamoDB Streams enabled on the ledger table
phases.exit_criteria: A ledger write reliably produces an event on the bus.

phases.name: Step Functions
includes: Step Functions state machine for the capture saga, including compensation
phases.exit_criteria: A capture flows through the saga to completion or compensation, with a notification sent.

phases.name: Aurora
phases.goal: Land ledger data in the relational read model.
includes: Aurora Serverless v2 and RDS Proxy
SQS between EventBridge and the projector
phases.exit_criteria: Ledger events reliably project into Aurora.

phases.name: Read Path
phases.goal: Serve read queries from Aurora and DynamoDB.
phases.exit_criteria: Both read endpoints serve real data.

phases.name: Resilience and Load Testing
phases.goal: Validate the system holds up under failure and load, and measure the assumptions the ADRs make.
includes: Chaos experiments: saga crash mid-flight, DynamoDB throttling, poisoned queue message, transaction-cancellation handling
Provisioned concurrency vs SnapStart vs cold starts, measured under load
phases.exit_criteria: Each induced failure is documented: what was induced, what the system did, what changed as a result.
